typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ROW_ID as double,
		BATCH_ID as double,
		SBSB_CK as integer,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		MEDICAID_ID as string,
		MEPE_EFF_DT as string,
		BLBP_CK as integer,
		BLBP_BILL_PER as integer,
		BLBP_EFF_DT as string,
		TAPE_DATE as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		RCPT_ID as string,
		BLEI_CK as integer,
		PAY_HUB as string,
		NO_OF_DAYS as double,
		VENDOR_REF_ID as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		RCPT_RCPT_CD as string,
		RCPT_MCTR_RSN as string,
		RCPT_AMT as integer,
		ERROR_ID as string,
		REVIEW_FLAG as string,
		UPDATED_BY as string,
		CREATED_BY as string,
		CREATE_DTM as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		UPDATE_DTM as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> InputPlaceHolderOracleSource
InputPlaceHolderOracleSource derive({Copy of UPDATE_DTM} = toString(UPDATE_DTM),
		{Copy of CREATE_DTM} = toString(CREATE_DTM)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of CREATE_DTM} as string,
		{Copy of UPDATE_DTM} as string,
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		{Copy of CREATE_DTM},
		{Copy of UPDATE_DTM},
		{})) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestination
